description: Build a single sprint or release test plan. Covers feature decomposition into testable scenarios, requirements-to-test coverage mapping, effort estimation by test type, prioritization matrices (risk × effort), resource allocation, and scheduling with buffers. Use when: "sprint test plan," "release test plan," "what to test this sprint," "test estimation," "coverage mapping." Not for: multi-quarter strategy — use `test-strategy`. Not for: ranking areas by risk — use `risk-based-testing`. Not for: the go/no-go decision itself — use `release-readiness`. Related: test-strategy, risk-based-testing, release-readiness.
